==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]].
He is also the boss of stage 5 of [[Raids#Storm Hideout|Storm Hideout]] in The Final Confrontation.
